caveat (StandardChecker: action, resource, task, layer, expiry).

div.div: Why support all three? The thesis question is which fits a dynamic continuum. A single PEP with three authenticators keeps everything else equal, so differences in latency, CPU and revocation window come from the credential alone. The production answer is likely a mix: mTLS between services, capabilities for delegated tasks, tokens for humans.

The production answer is likely a mix: mTLS between services, capabilities for delegated tasks, tokens for
humans.
